content: RequestFileTransfer Type: valid Description: The Diagnostic Extract shall support the configuration of UDS service 0x38 (RequestFileTransfer). Rationale: The service RequestFileTransfer is part of the subset of UDS services supported by the Diagnostic Extract. Use Case: The user wants to specify a file transfer to/from the server.
